boundary_rule_intended: A future holdout MUST be: (a) a contiguous EURUSD time window, (b) with zero overlap with any window in dataset_role_contract.json's consumed_windows, (c) confirmed via a dedicated provenance audit (not this mission) that no prior AG mission, script, or manual analysis has inspected it in any form.
why_not_available: dataset_role_contract.json classifies everything outside the confirmed 2025-08-01..2025-10-01 consumed window as UNKNOWN provenance, not verified untouched. Per this mission's explicit instruction ('Unknown provenance must fail closed' / 'Do not manufacture a holdout merely to obtain PASS'), UNKNOWN cannot be promoted to HOLDOUT_RESERVED without a dedicated audit this mission did not perform. This mirrors ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1's own precedent, where holdout reservation was handled as its own explicit, separate governance action, not a byproduct of an admission-contract mission.
admission_effect: StrategyValidationProfile.holdout_metadata for ST_LARGE_SMC_V1/EURUSD remains None -- VALIDATION_ADMISSION will continue to report MISSING_HOLDOUT_BOUNDARY until a dedicated holdout-provenance audit establishes a genuinely untouched window and an owner authorizes its reservation.
next_step: A separate, dedicated mission (analogous to ST_SESSION_SWEEP_CONTINUATION_V1's holdout-reservation work) is required before this contract can move past NOT_AVAILABLE.
